title: 工業棕地風險評估
summary: 本課以「將棕地歷史、採樣品質與暴露路徑轉為可檢查的風險概念模型」為主軸，依序處理場址使用史與概念圖、空間異質性與採樣設計、介質濃度與接觸量、地下水途徑與遷移、不確定度與決策敏感度。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Turn brownfield history, sampling quality and exposure pathways into an auditable risk model, progressing through Site history and conceptual diagram, Spatial heterogeneity and sampling design, Media concentration and contact quantity, Groundwater pathway and migration, Uncertainty and decision sensitivity. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

steps.title: 場址使用史與概念圖：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Site history and conceptual diagram: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 場址使用史與概念圖 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Site history and conceptual diagram and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在虛構工業地圖標記儲槽、裝卸、排水與回填活動，先提出可被採樣推翻的污染假說。 網格數需向上取整；空間覆蓋與熱點偵測機率是不同的採樣設計問題。
steps.instructionEn: Mark tanks, loading, drains and fill on a fictional industrial map and formulate contamination hypotheses that sampling can challenge. Grid counts round upward; spatial coverage and hotspot detection probability are different sampling-design questions.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：抽樣區域 A=10000 m²；每格面積 a=400 m²。公式 N=ceil(A/a)，計算得 25 sample cells。適用邊界：規則平面網格計數，未指定法規採樣密度或統計信賴。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Survey area A=10000 m²; grid-cell area a=400 m². Formula N=ceil(A/a) gives 25 sample cells. Applicability: Regular planar-grid counting, not a regulatory density or statistical confidence claim.
steps.failure: 規則網格漏掉小型污染熱點，需與歷史與現場證據合併。 在「場址使用史與概念圖」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: A regular grid may miss small hotspots and must be combined with history and field evidence. Mark where this error can enter the Site history and conceptual diagram flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「場址使用史與概念圖」，將網格覆在地形與歷史活動圖上，保留障礙區與針對性樣本的理由。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Site history and conceptual diagram, Overlay the grid on terrain and historical activities; document inaccessible cells and targeted samples. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只將 a 改成 300 m²，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 25 變成 34 sample cells。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
knowledge.textEn: Change only cell area a to 300 m², holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 25 to 34 sample cells. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

steps.title: 污染源、途徑與受體：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Source, pathway and receptor: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 污染源、途徑與受體 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Source, pathway and receptor and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 為現況工人、鄰近居民與未來用途分開畫接觸路徑，未完整路徑仍需標明被切斷的依據。 介質濃度乘接觸量才形成暴露質量；受體行為與接觸路徑決定分析邊界。
steps.instructionEn: Map pathways separately for workers, neighbours and future uses, documenting evidence where a pathway is incomplete. Media concentration multiplied by contact quantity gives exposure mass; receptor behaviour and pathway define the boundary.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：土中 C=10 mg/kg；假想土壤接觸攝入量 I=50 mg/day。公式 intake=C*I/1e6，計算得 0.0005 mg/day。適用邊界：純單位換算的假想接觸例，未含生體可用率、體重或毒性；非個人健康評估。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Soil C=10 mg/kg; hypothetical soil ingestion contact I=50 mg/day. Formula intake=C*I/1e6 gives 0.0005 mg/day. Applicability: A hypothetical unit-conversion example without bioavailability, body mass or toxicity; not an individual health assessment.
steps.failure: 漏掉 mg 土壤轉 kg 的因子會產生百萬倍誤差。 在「污染源、途徑與受體」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
